interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the fields, the two remember options and what happens on Login.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through signing in as another account.

interactive.label: server
interactive.tooltip: Host name or address of the MMFDB server. Type one, or pick a remembered server below.

interactive.label: port
interactive.tooltip: Command port of the MMFDB server (1 to 65535). The publish port is the next one.

interactive.label: user
interactive.tooltip: The account to sign in as. Type any account name, or pick one below.

interactive.label: password
interactive.tooltip: The account's password. It is shown as stars and never stored.

interactive.label: Save selected user
interactive.tooltip: Remember this account as the default one for the next start.

interactive.label: Log in automatically when allowed
interactive.tooltip: Keep a session token in the operating system's credential store so the next start signs in without a password.

interactive.label: Login
interactive.tooltip: Authenticate against the MMFDB. On success the account and server are remembered and the window closes.

interactive.label: Cancel
interactive.tooltip: Close without changing the active user.
